visual.general_description: Composite of five panels: orbit MRI, a VEP trace, a left eye visual field printout, an RNFL report and fluorescence cell-assay images.
visual.detailed_description: Five stacked framed panels lettered A to E. A is an axial grayscale MRI at orbit level. B is a single visual evoked potential trace with marked deflections. C is an OS visual field printout with deviation grids, symbol maps and global indices. D is a two-eye RNFL report with thickness profiles, sector circles and classification boxes. E is a row of three fluorescence microscopy fields.

panels.general_description: Grayscale axial MRI slice through the orbits.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale axial MRI slice at the level of the orbits. Both globes are bright and rounded with a dark small lens or anterior segment area, and both optic nerves are visible as gray bands running from the posterior globes toward the orbital apex. Dark air-filled sinus and bony regions lie between the orbits, and parts of the temporal lobes and brainstem region appear posteriorly. Short horizontal scale tick marks run down the right edge. No arrows, text overlays other than the panel letter, or signal-change markers are visible.

panels.general_description: Visual field printout for the left eye with total and pattern deviation maps.
panels.detailed_description: Automated perimetry printout labeled OS at the upper right. Two numeric grids of per-location deviation values are shown at the top: the left grid (total deviation) has mostly negative values, roughly between -5 and -16 in the readable cells, and the right grid (pattern deviation) has mostly small values between about 0 and -9 with a few values of 0 or 1. Beneath them, probability symbol maps are titled Total deviation and Pattern deviation in blue; the total deviation map is filled almost everywhere with black squares and patterned symbols, while the pattern deviation map is mostly small dots with a few patterned or solid symbols at the nasal edge and lower field. A legend lists symbols for P < 5%, P < 2%, P < 1% and P < 0.5%. Text at the right reads GHT Marginal/overall reduction, VFI 93%, MD24-2 -8.47 dB P < 0.5% and PSD24-2 2.23 dB P < 5%.

panels.general_description: Optical coherence tomography style RNFL report for both eyes with classification boxes.
panels.detailed_description: Report-style printout. At the top, two line plots of retinal nerve fiber layer thickness against position around the disc (0 to 360 with TMP, SUP, NAS, INF, TMP) are drawn on green, yellow and red normative bands; the left plot has a black trace dipping toward zero in the superior-nasal region and the right plot shows a trace with several narrow drops to zero between about 120 and 170. A color key between them reads Within Normal Limits (>5%), Borderline (<5%) and Outside Normal Limits (<1%). A central overlay plot shows both eye traces labeled OD and OS. At the sides are two four-sector circles: the right-eye circle has S 98, T 98, N 42 (yellow) and I 135, and the left-eye circle has S 121, T 93, N 28 (red) and I 119. Below each are six-sector circles with parenthesized values and a central G value; the left-eye nasal sector is red. Classification boxes read Classification OD Borderline (yellow) and Classification OS Outside Normal Limits (red). The footer reads Reference database: European Descent (2009).

visual.detailed_description: Chart on a white background with two shaded regions: a pale green region on the left titled Fixed Cell Based Assay (CBA) and a pale yellow region to the right titled Live-CBA. The vertical axis is categorical with ticks Negative, 1:10, 1:32 and 1:100, with a double slash break between 1:32 and 1:100. The horizontal axis has six dated labels: 2023.5.6 with Symptoms onset below it, 2023.12.3, 2024.3.13 with Initiate satralizumab below it, 2024.10.10, 2025.3.19 and 2025.7.23. A legend at the upper right shows red dots for AQP4-IgG and blue dots for MOG-IgG, each series joined by dash-dot lines. Red points: 1:32, 1:10, 1:10, Negative, Negative, 1:10. Blue points: Negative, Negative, 1:32, 1:100, 1:32, 1:32. A yellow diamond sits at the 2024.3.13 label, a green diamond labeled pregnant lies between 2024.3.13 and 2024.10.10, and a green diamond labeled delivery lies between 2025.3.19 and 2025.7.23, with a pale green band between the two diamonds. A yellow arrow below the axis reads Satralizumab continued treatment and extends from near 2024.3.13 to the right edge.
